analyst.text: The Security Council invites the United Nations to include in existing reports on situations on the Council’s agenda, where relevant, information on how climate impacts affect local conditions, drawing on the views of affected countries and respecting the role of the inclusive UN climate process.
analyst.reason: The UK would gain reporting across relevant situations, and France could use it to assess risks case by case. Using existing reports could accommodate India’s objection to treating climate change as a separate security issue while preserving the inclusive process it supports.
